init.title: Optim Energy options
init.description: Audit mode logs the commands and REST requests that would be denied; use it only to validate an upgrade. Reading Shelly devices from the MQTT broker makes a device, with a sensor for every value it reports, for each Shelly heard on the broker Home Assistant is connected to. Every message is written as it arrives. It only listens and never sends anything to the broker.
